name: gtmx-agents-site-workspace
//devDependencies: Biome lives ONLY here, at the root, because biome.jsonc is a root-level config that covers the whole repo — one binary, one version, one source of truth. TypeScript is a per-package dep (site/package.json) since each package runs its own tsc against its own tsconfig.
//pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies: pnpm 10 blocks postinstall scripts by default. These three legitimately need theirs: esbuild and workerd fetch/verify their platform binaries (wrangler dev fails without workerd's), and @tailwindcss/oxide compiles the Rust scanner. Anything not listed here stays blocked — that is the point.
